## As asked

<!-- harbour-periodical-gate id="seams-tangles" -->
"Live proof run for LIN-4349 P1 (LIN-4379, merged 066e85cb, deployed f8b946d4): Seams & Tangles now writes area notes via a docs PR and mints no follow-up tickets. Record the run and its PR on LIN-4349."

**The line above is the operator note, carried verbatim.** It says why this run exists: it is the first live run of Seams & Tangles under the LIN-4379 contract (findings go into the area notes through one docs-only PR, no follow-up tickets). It is context, not scope. Recording the run and its PR on LIN-4349 is one closing comment there, not a change to what this review covers.

Repository: `JKershaw/LinearViewer` (Harbour), branch `main`. Minted at `f8b946d404b78c09bea4e768174929468d25aa39`. Re-ground everything below against live `main` when you start; the figures here are a starting point, not findings.

## What this is

Seams & Tangles periodical, **run 10**: the direction and tangling *between areas* (knots, wrong-way dependencies, hubs, ways in, rebuild readiness, guide-vs-graph naming, change coupling), framed as a delta against run 9. Review-only: the deliverable is a report plus area-note entries, merged in one docs-only PR, then this task concluded.

## Starting scope (audit it and widen it before you execute)

Treat this as a floor. Before running the review, look for surfaces in this remit that are not listed here and fold them in. A scope you could only shrink is suspect. Widen *what you examine*, never *what you report*: the report stays uncapped and severity-ranked (a near-empty result is a genuine outcome), and the area notes get an entry only where a finding binds a builder or waits in an area, each note under its cap.

**Previous run (read it first).** `docs/reviews/seams-tangles-review-2026-11-06-run9.md` (LIN-4323, PR #2333, merge `fa3bd87a`), evidence `docs/reviews/_evidence-2026-11-06-run9/`. It measured `90542b2c79016d2a1d64f75cb5d3e9037080eae7` against run 8's `af55cb73`. Its §10 trend ledger is the list you delta against: F1 `knot:agents-chat<->runs` High (31/37); F6 `knot:browser-window-globals` Medium; N1 `knot:other-features-catch-all` Medium (17 files); F4 `knot:runs->agent-api(proxy-preamble)` Medium; `seam:periodical-mint` (residue Medium, owned by LIN-4318); `hub:periodicals.js` Low–Medium watch; N6 `hub:cost-read.js`; `map:stage-kind-roster`; `seam:stage-contract`; F3, F5, F7, F8, N2–N12, `hub:dispatch-store.js`, `hub:run-controls.js`, `hub:tree.js`, `hub:render-run-steps.js`, `wiring: server.js`. Earlier runs (run 1 `2026-10-13` … run 8 `2026-11-05-run8`) sit beside it in `docs/reviews/`. Keep the stable names; retire or add names explicitly.

**The window:** `90542b2c..main`**.** At mint: 35 first-parent commits, 86 production files changed (+4339 / −882), 9 production files added: `lib/as-asked.js`, `lib/as-asked-seal.js`, `lib/size-of-move.js`, `lib/call-budget.js`, `lib/dispatch-leftover.js`, `lib/dispatch-leftover-hook.js`, `lib/prompts/leftover-words.js`, `lib/prompts/area-registry-path.js`, `lib/sample-data/fixture-parent.js`. The window's themes (LIN numbers from the merge titles): the As-asked block and its seals/proxy guard (LIN-4351/4352/4353/4360/4362), size of the move and the size-record proxy guard (LIN-4345/4367/4368/4369), the builder's leftover step and close-out writing notes (LIN-4373/4374/4375/4376), the area registry and notes (LIN-4371) and Seams & Tangles' own Stage 2 (LIN-4379), one issue access per dispatch (LIN-4354/4361), call-layer budget (LIN-4358), per-credential rate limit (LIN-4378), held-wake primitives (LIN-4383), the runner contract pins (LIN-4384), nested-connection paging (LIN-4322), close-out onto `loadWorld` (LIN-4312). Leads worth checking, not conclusions: at mint `lib/as-asked-seal.js` maps to the `^lib/` catch-all (Other features) while `lib/as-asked.js` maps to LLM & prompts, which bears on N1; `lib/periodicals.js` grew from 1259 to 1318 lines with Stage 2, which bears on `hub:periodicals.js`; the As-asked and size-record guards sit in the proxy, which may add Agent API ↔ LLM or Runs edges.

**The guide moved and was edited in this window, and so did the tool. Handle both explicitly.**

* The area guide is now `docs/areas/areas.json` (the product's area registry, LIN-4371, `526bca66`). Until then it was `scripts/code-shape/areas.json` (blob `642e9405`, the guide run 9 used). The HEAD registry (blob `c988f5c5` at mint) adds a `slug` to every area and adds `as-asked`, `size-of-move` and `call-budget` to the LLM & prompts pattern. Run both commits with **the one HEAD registry**, so a difference is code that moved. Then record the guide edit separately: re-run `90542b2c` with run 9's guide too, and state what the guide edit alone moved.
* `scripts/code-shape/seams.mjs` and `code-shape-lib.mjs` changed in the window (the default guide path, among other things). Read `scripts/code-shape/README.md` for how to run them, run the HEAD tool at both commits, and check that the HEAD tool reproduces run 9's `90542b2c` figures with run 9's guide before you trust any delta. Report any difference as a tool change, not code movement.

**Change coupling.** `scripts/code-shape/cochange.mjs` with `--days 60` (the window length run 9 used) at `90542b2c` and HEAD, the same HEAD registry for both. Run 9's totals were 891 changes / 393 multi-area / 76 unmapped; its top pairs and its 19 no-link pairs are in its §6 and §10. Report `unmappedFiles` and `shallow`. A pair that changes together often with no import link is a candidate seam; this window's notes/leftover/As-asked work spans several areas in single changes, so read it in that light. Pairs of areas only: per-file churn is the Stability Review's.

**Siblings: mind the altitude, do not double-flag.** Drift & Coherence owns decisions held in several places and file-to-file direction (latest: `docs/reviews/drift-coherence-review-2026-11-06.md`, run 5, LIN-4324). Code Quality owns function size (`code-quality-review-2026-11-04.md`). Stability owns churn (`stability-review-2026-11-04.md`). Comprehension Debt and API Quality have their own series in `docs/reviews/`. Cross-link them; a seam between two of their remits that none of them owns is still in this one's. Run 9's §11 lists the hand-offs it made; check whether they were taken.

**Known-issues surfaces to read.** `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/architecture/source-map.md`, `docs/areas/README.md` and the notes, `tests/unit/area-map-placement.test.js` (placements pinned because they were once wrong), inline markers in the window's files, and open tickets. Owners at mint: LIN-4318 (Backlog, periodical mint by id; owns the text-keyed grant residue), LIN-4028 (In Progress) and PR #2185 (would add `lib/routing-ruling.js` to the catch-all), LIN-4193 (Backlog, cost modules into an area), LIN-4258/4259, LIN-3738, LIN-3737, LIN-3555, LIN-3922/3923, LIN-3736. Re-read their states; a finding already filed as a ticket stays in the report only.

 1. **Read prior runs first; this review is trend-aware.** Frame every knot as new, unchanged, improved, worsened or resolved against run 9. Report changes since run 9 first.
 2. **Run the measuring tools; do not re-derive the numbers by searching.** Record the full commit you measured.  7. **One docs-only pull request** holding the report, its evidence folder and the note edits, on a `feat/lin-<id>-…` branch (the repo's convention). Rebase it onto `main`, get `ci-success` and the notes guard green, and merge it yourself: it is docs-only. Post one comment on this task carrying, together in one body: `Adversarial second-read verdict: AGREE` or `Adversarial second-read verdict: DISAGREE`; `Differed from top finding: YES` or `Differed from top finding: NO` (whether the reader's answer differed from the report's top-ranked finding, independent of the verdict); and `Disposition: fixed in place`, `Disposition: escalated` or `Disposition: no change`. The engine refuses Done until all three are in one comment. Copy them into a `## Adversarial Second-Read` section of the report with the tier, the question and the reader's answer in full. AGREE and DISAGREE both conclude normally; DISAGREE is itself the escalation.
 9. **Then conclude; do not leave this task open.** Post a concise severity-ranked summary as a comment here, with the report's path, the merged PR, any larger tidy and any finding with no area file to cite, addressed to the person. Add a short comment on LIN-4349 naming this run and its PR (the operator note). Then move this task to Done.
10. **Stay review-only.** Change no code, config or secrets, and no docs beyond the report, its evidence folder and the area-note edits. Do not edit `docs/areas/areas.json` itself; guide edits are proposals in the report.

*End of what was asked. Steps write below this line; nothing above it changes.*

# Research notes: Seams & Tangles run 10 (research stage)

Research only. Nothing was committed and no PR was opened. The figures below come from the HEAD tools run in a scratch folder. The build stage re-runs them into `docs/reviews/_evidence-2026-11-08-run10/` and checks `main` again before it writes anything.

## 0. Re-grounding

- **Live `main` = `32da8d5835a3b9d64a6ab3d0a696dc95aef1f6f2`**, one merge past the mint SHA `f8b946d4`. The extra merge is #2368 (LIN-4383 follow-up). It touches `lib/dispatch-store.js` (a 1-line change), a test, and `docs/areas/runs-and-dispatch.md` (+9 lines, which takes the note to **6056 / 6144 bytes**). No import edge changed between `f8b946d4` and `32da8d58` (edge dumps match).
- **Window `90542b2c..32da8d58`:** 36 first-parent commits. Production code (`lib routes public server.js`): 86 files, +4339 / −882, 9 files added (the ticket's list is exact), 0 deleted.
- `git log --since=2026-11-08T12:10:42Z` on the ticket's paths shows only #2368.

## 1. The tools and the guide (layer: measurement)

- **Tool blobs** at `90542b2c` → HEAD: `seams.mjs` `34f11434`→`3049404a`, `code-shape-lib.mjs` `42a1e521`→`724d737c`, `cochange-core.mjs` `763a37b8`→`c8c55868`. `cochange.mjs` is unchanged at `c3a39f37`. The diff is a refactor. `claimedBy` moved into `code-shape-lib.mjs`, and seams and cochange share it. `DEFAULT_AREAS` now resolves through `REGISTRY_PATH` (`lib/prompts/area-registry-path.js`, LIN-4383). The commits are `526bca66` (LIN-4371), `110e35e0` (LIN-4376) and `caa38c69` (LIN-4383).
